dependencies.scope: diffuse rank-r core with arbitrary coordinate-separable phases
codimension-one same-sign spectral density bound C_same/L

mathematical_change.statement: A diffuse low-rank core remains bounded-density and continuous after an arbitrary nonseparable perturbation whose off-diagonal interaction graph has a low-leverage original-coordinate vertex cover. Conditioning on that cover and whitening the retained frame costs det(I-U_S^T U_S)^(-1/r); a trace sufficient bound is 1/(1-tau_S).
mathematical_change.rank3_example_bound: 18e when |det Lambda|>=1, all row leverages<=1/12, and the perturbation off-diagonal graph has a vertex cover of total leverage<=5/6.
mathematical_change.partner_application: A physical block with m-1 same-sign eigenvalues >=L gives <24.193/L; an operator perturbation <=delta L inside that block gives <24.193/((1-delta)L), with arbitrary outside completion.

unresolved_implication: From only three large eigenvalues, derive a product-preserving decomposition whose nonseparable remainder has a sufficiently low-leverage vertex cover, or prove a genuinely nonseparable diffuse Fourier/Brascamp-Lieb estimate.
next_step: Test whether sparse graph decompositions of the spectral remainder or a block-geometric Brascamp-Lieb extension can remove the vertex-cover requirement without reintroducing post-rotation independence.
continuity_status: PROVED only for the vertex-cover diffuse subclass in this run; OPEN for the full target
